skills.why_en: Take one good look with your own eyes first. Then you'll really feel what the telescope adds.
skills.why_zh: 先用自己的眼睛好好看看，之后换望远镜，差别才真切。
skills.action_en: Use A/D and W/S to sweep across the sky. Guide the Moon into the center circle, then press Observe.
skills.action_zh: 用 A/D 和 W/S 扫视天空，把月亮送进中央引导圈，再按“观测”。
skills.success_en: There you go—the Moon's sitting right in the circle, and Observe just lit up.
skills.success_zh: 看见了吗？月亮稳稳落在圈里，“观测”也亮起来了。
skills.recovery_en: Moon slipped out of view? Follow the edge arrow and its Az/Alt hints—no need to guess.
skills.recovery_zh: 月亮跑出画面了？跟着边缘箭头和 Az/Alt 提示转，别靠猜。

skills.why_en: The Moon is an easy catch because it's bright. A dimmer star is where your eyes really get tested.
skills.why_zh: 月亮亮，很容易看见；换成暗些的恒星，才真考验眼力。
skills.action_en: Use the direction hint to find Polaris in the wide naked-eye view, then ease that tiny point into the center.
skills.action_zh: 看着方向提示，在肉眼的大视野里找北极星，再把小星点移到中央。
skills.success_en: That's it—the tiny point is Polaris. You found it with your own eyes, no magnification needed.
skills.success_zh: 对，就是那个小星点。没放大，你也亲眼找到了北极星。
skills.recovery_en: Can't spot it? Start with the target arrow. In naked-eye view, a star really is just a tiny point.
skills.recovery_zh: 一时找不到就先跟目标箭头走；肉眼里的恒星，本来就只是小星点。

skills.why_en: The objective has to gather the light and form an image before the eyepiece can magnify it. The order matters.
skills.why_zh: 得先让物镜聚光成像，目镜才能放大；这条光路的顺序不能乱。
skills.action_en: Choose a part card on the left, then its highlighted slot on the blueprint. Go objective, tube, then eyepiece.
skills.action_zh: 点左侧零件卡，再点蓝图中对应的高亮槽位；按物镜、镜筒、目镜来装。
skills.success_en: Nice—the objective, tube, and eyepiece are all in place. You've built the whole light path.
skills.success_zh: 漂亮，物镜、镜筒和目镜都接好了，整条光路已经搭起来了。
skills.recovery_en: Part bounced back? Check Compatibility in the Inspector on the right—it'll point out the wrong slot or family.
skills.recovery_zh: 零件被退回了？看看右侧检查器的 Compatibility，是槽位还是家族不合。

skills.why_en: You can aim perfectly and still get a blur. That just means the eyepiece hasn't reached the focal plane yet.
skills.why_zh: 瞄得再准也可能发糊，只是目镜还没落到焦平面上。
skills.action_en: Nudge the focus with Q/E. Watch the edges, halo, and double image tighten up instead of chasing the percentage.
skills.action_zh: 用 Q/E 一点点调焦，盯着边缘、光晕和重影怎么收紧，别只追百分比。
skills.success_en: Right there—the edge is crisp, and the halo and double image have both settled down.
skills.success_zh: 就是这里——边缘利落，光晕和重影也都收住了。
skills.recovery_en: If it gets blurrier, go back the other way. Near the clearest point, use shorter taps.
skills.recovery_zh: 越调越糊就往回走，快到最清楚的位置时，改成短按。

skills.why_en: More magnification makes details bigger, but you lose some sky, brightness, and stability.
skills.why_zh: 倍率越高，细节越大，可视野会变窄、变暗，漂移也更明显。
skills.action_en: Compare the eyepieces first. Find the target at low power, then switch to the requested magnification and center it again.
skills.action_zh: 先比比几只目镜。低倍找到目标，再换成要求的倍率，重新把它放回中央。
skills.success_en: There it is—the eyepiece change didn't lose the target, and now you can make out the detail.
skills.success_zh: 这就对了，换了目镜，目标没跑，细节也出来了。
skills.recovery_en: Lost it after zooming in? Switch back to the wider eyepiece, recenter it, and try again.
skills.recovery_zh: 升倍率后找不到了？换回宽视野目镜，重新对准，再试一次。

skills.why_en: The main telescope sees too little sky to search comfortably. The finder's wider view helps you bring the target in first.
skills.why_zh: 主镜视野太窄，不好直接搜；寻星镜视野更宽，能先帮你抓住目标。
skills.action_en: Install the finder, enter Finder mode, then use I/J/K/L to put its crosshair on the same target as the main telescope.
skills.action_zh: 先装上寻星镜，进入寻星镜模式，再用 I/J/K/L 把准星移到主镜看到的同一目标上。
skills.success_en: See that gold flash? Nice—the finder and the main telescope are looking at the same spot now.
skills.success_zh: 看，准星闪金了！寻星镜和主镜现在看的是同一个地方。
skills.recovery_en: If a delta grows, move the other way. Adjust one axis at a time so you can follow each change.
skills.recovery_zh: 差值越调越大就反向来，一次只动一个轴，变化会更好看懂。

skills.why_en: A faint target needs more light, not just a bigger image. More magnification alone only makes the dim blur larger.
skills.why_zh: 暗目标缺的是光，不是尺寸；只加倍率，不过是把暗影放大。
skills.action_en: In the Parts Cabinet, equip a larger objective that's compatible with this mission, then install it at the Assembly Table.
skills.action_zh: 去零件柜装备本关兼容的大口径物镜，再到组装台把它装进蓝图。
skills.success_en: Much better—the faint target is brighter now. That larger aperture really is gathering more light.
skills.success_zh: 好多了，暗目标亮起来了；大口径确实收进了更多光。
skills.recovery_en: If it won't install, check the telescope family, the part type, and this mission's Required list.
skills.recovery_zh: 装不上就查一下望远镜家族、零件类型，还有本关的 Required 列表。

skills.why_en: Nebulae and galaxies spread their light over a wide area instead of shining from one bright point, so contrast matters more here.
skills.why_zh: 星云和星系的光铺得很开，不会亮成一点，所以这里更看重对比度。
skills.action_en: Use a wide eyepiece, give your eyes time to adapt to the dark, and hold the target steady. Look slowly for a faint, spread-out glow.
skills.action_zh: 用宽视野目镜，等眼睛适应黑暗，把目标稳住，再慢慢找那片淡淡的延展光。
skills.success_en: See that? That faint outline is holding steady now.
skills.success_zh: 看见了吗？那团淡淡的轮廓稳稳浮出来了。
skills.recovery_en: Only the center is showing right now. Lower the magnification, then try again once it's darker and steadier.
skills.recovery_zh: 现在只看得到中心。先降点倍率，等环境更暗、画面更稳再试。

skills.why_en: That colored rim around the bright star isn't your hand shaking. A refractor bends each color a little differently.
skills.why_zh: 亮星边上那圈彩色，不是你手抖。折射镜会让不同颜色弯得不太一样。
skills.action_en: Get the star as sharp as you can, then check its edge. If the center is sharp but the color remains, that's chromatic aberration.
skills.action_zh: 先把星点调到最清楚，再看边缘。中心清楚、彩边还在，才是色差。
skills.success_en: Yep, that's it—the center is sharp, but the colored rim is still there. Your focus is fine.
skills.success_zh: 对，就是它：中心明明清楚，彩边却还在。你的对焦没问题。
skills.recovery_en: If the whole star looks soft, refocus first. Plain old blur isn't chromatic aberration.
skills.recovery_zh: 整颗星都糊的话，先重新对焦；普通失焦可别当成色差。

skills.why_en: Mirrors avoid lens colour fringing and can gather more light, but the primary and secondary must work as one aligned system.
skills.why_zh: 反射镜没有透镜彩边，还能做得更大。不过主镜和副镜得对成一条光路。
skills.action_en: Build the optical tube subassembly, install the mirrors, spider and side focuser, then return the completed OTA to the main blueprint.
skills.action_zh: 先打开镜筒子装配，装好主镜、副镜、蜘蛛支架和侧置调焦器。保存后再把完整镜筒装回主蓝图。
skills.success_en: The optical path is complete and the main blueprint shows the finished Newtonian OTA in its slot.
skills.success_zh: 光路完成后，主蓝图的镜筒槽位会显示完整的牛顿式 OTA。
skills.recovery_en: If the OTA cannot be saved, inspect the subassembly checklist; a missing internal component cannot be replaced by a main-bench part.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果无法保存镜筒，请检查子装配清单；缺少的内部组件不能用主装配台零件代替。

skills.why_en: A complete Newtonian can still produce asymmetric, smeared stars when its mirrors do not share one optical axis.
skills.why_zh: 零件齐了还不够。几块镜面没有共轴，星点照样会偏、会拖尾。
skills.action_en: Adjust the collimation controls while watching the optical-axis lines and score move together.
skills.action_zh: 一次只动一个准直旋钮。看光轴线往哪边走，也看星点有没有变得更对称。
skills.success_en: The optical path turns green, the rings lock concentrically, and Collimation complete appears.
skills.success_zh: 光轴变绿，几个圆环也同心锁住了。这样才算准直完成。
skills.recovery_en: If the score falls, undo the last direction and correct one mirror axis at a time.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果分数下降，就反向撤回刚才的调整，并一次只修正一个镜面轴。

skills.why_en: Don't stare straight at something this faint. Once your eyes adjust to the dark, your peripheral vision can pick it up more easily.
skills.why_zh: 暗淡的天体别死盯中心。眼睛适应黑暗后，用旁边的视野反而更容易看见。
skills.action_en: Let your eyes adjust first, then hold Shift and look just beside the target instead of staring at its center.
skills.action_zh: 先等暗适应，再按住 Shift，让视线落在目标旁边，别直盯中心。
skills.success_en: There—the faint structure just came out. The object didn't move; your averted vision kicked in.
skills.success_zh: 看，刚才藏着的暗纹理浮出来了；天体没动，是你的侧视起作用了。
skills.recovery_en: Keep holding Shift and leave the telescope still—don't touch W/S/A/D. Hold your gaze beside the target for a moment.
skills.recovery_zh: 继续按住 Shift，望远镜别动，也别碰 W/S/A/D；把视线稳在目标旁边一会儿。

skills.why_en: It isn't wandering off on its own—the Earth is turning beneath us. At high magnification, that drift is hard to miss.
skills.why_zh: 它慢慢滑走不是自己在跑，是地球在转；倍率一高，就更藏不住了。
skills.action_en: Turn tracking on and set the rate near 1.0x. If it keeps drifting the same way, nudge it up; if it reverses, nudge it down.
skills.action_zh: 打开追踪，把速率调到 1.0x 附近。还顺着漂就加一点，反向漂就减一点。
skills.success_en: Nice, it's staying put in the view now. You dialed that tracking rate in really well.
skills.success_zh: 稳住了，它一直待在视野里。这个追踪速率调得很准。
skills.recovery_en: If it's still drifting the same way, raise the rate a little. If it starts drifting backward, lower it again.
skills.recovery_zh: 还沿原方向漂，就把速率加一点；要是反向漂，再减一点。

skills.why_en: If it's in focus but still shimmers or seems to boil at the edges, moving air is bending the light. The focus knob isn't broken.
skills.why_zh: 焦点对了还会抖、边缘像在翻滚，是空气流动在弯折光线，不是旋钮坏了。
skills.action_en: Get the focus right first, then watch for a few seconds. Constant blur means bad focus; brief sharp moments mixed with wobble are the atmosphere.
skills.action_zh: 先把焦点调准，再多看几秒。一直糊是失焦，忽清忽抖才是大气扰动。
skills.success_en: Yes, that steady moment! You caught the detail beautifully.
skills.success_zh: 对，就是稳下来的那一瞬！细节抓得很漂亮。
skills.recovery_en: If it never stops wobbling, leave the focus knob alone. Drop the magnification or wait for steadier air.
skills.recovery_zh: 一直抖就别拧调焦旋钮了，降点倍率，或者耐心等它稳下来。

skills.why_en: A Dobsonian trades motorised precision for a stable, bright, simple mount that you guide by hand.
skills.why_zh: 多布森用手动控制换来稳定、明亮而简单的支架，需要玩家亲自跟随目标。
skills.action_en: Build the rocker-base telescope, then use gentle A/D and W/S nudges instead of long key holds.
skills.action_zh: 组装摇箱底座望远镜后，用轻柔的 A/D、W/S 点按修正，不要长时间按住。
skills.success_en: The target stays near center without overshoot while the larger mirror provides a brighter view.
skills.success_zh: 目标不会因过冲离开中心，大口径主镜同时提供更明亮的画面。
skills.recovery_en: If you overshoot, stop, let the view settle, and correct with a shorter tap in the opposite direction.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果推过头，先停下等待画面稳定，再向反方向短按修正。

skills.why_en: More magnification isn't always better. It enlarges the blur, atmospheric wobble, and tracking errors too.
skills.why_zh: 倍率不是越高越好；画面放大时，模糊、抖动和追踪误差也会一起放大。
skills.action_en: Try both eyepieces and keep the highest power that still looks bright, steady, and detailed.
skills.action_zh: 两枚目镜都试试，选画面仍然明亮、稳定、细节清楚的最高倍率。
skills.success_en: Nice choice—the surface detail is clearer, and the view is still steady.
skills.success_zh: 这档倍率选得漂亮，表面细节更清楚，画面也还稳着。
skills.recovery_en: If it only gets bigger, not clearer, step back to the lower magnification. It'll actually look better.
skills.recovery_zh: 只变大没变清楚，就退回低一档倍率，反而更好看。

skills.why_en: Even with the focus and equipment set correctly, a cloud can still dim the target. Don't rush to refocus.
skills.why_zh: 焦点和设备没问题，云照样会把目标压暗；这时别急着重新调焦。
skills.action_en: Hold the target steady and wait for the cloud to move on. Once the brightness returns, press Observe.
skills.action_zh: 先稳住目标，等云移开、亮度回来，再按下“观测”。
skills.success_en: You caught the break in the clouds! The target is bright again, and this view is beautifully clear.
skills.success_zh: 云缝赶上了！目标重新亮起来，这一眼真清楚。
skills.recovery_en: Don't chase a cloud with the focus knob. Keep the target centered and wait it out; if it lingers, use Change Site.
skills.recovery_zh: 别拿调焦追着云跑。保持目标在中央，等云过去；不行就点“更换地点”。

skills.why_en: The telescope is fine. City glow brightens the sky behind the target, so faint objects get washed out.
skills.why_zh: 望远镜没坏，是城市天光把背景照亮了，暗目标就容易被淹没。
skills.action_en: Note what you can see here, then view the same kind of target from a darker site and compare the two.
skills.action_zh: 先记下这里能看到的细节，再去更暗的地点看同类目标，把两次结果放一起比。
skills.success_en: See the difference? The darker site brings out much more of that faint structure.
skills.success_zh: 看见差别了吧？更暗的地点露出了更多微弱结构。
skills.recovery_en: If sky glow washes it out, lower any unnecessary magnification, let your eyes adapt to the dark, or choose Change Site.
skills.recovery_zh: 目标被天光冲淡时，降低不必要的倍率，让眼睛适应黑暗，或点“更换地点”。

skills.why_en: Two mirrors fold a long focal length into a compact tube, giving high image scale with a narrow field.
skills.why_zh: 两面反射镜把长焦距折叠进紧凑镜筒，带来高成像尺度，也带来更窄视野。
skills.action_en: Install only Cassegrain-compatible optics, then locate with Eye and Finder before entering the main telescope view.
skills.action_zh: 只安装兼容卡塞格林的光学零件，并先用肉眼和寻星镜定位，再进入主望远镜视野。
skills.success_en: The compact tube delivers a large detailed target without skipping the required aiming stages.
skills.success_zh: 紧凑镜筒能提供更大的细节图像，同时不会跳过必要的定位阶段。
skills.recovery_en: If the target is lost, do not keep searching at high power; return to Finder and recenter.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果目标丢失，不要继续在高倍率中盲找；返回寻星镜重新居中。

skills.why_en: Infrared reveals cool and dust-hidden structures, but the observatory must deploy fully and stay cold.
skills.why_zh: 红外能看见冷结构和尘埃后面的东西。不过望远镜得先展开，还得把自己冷下来。
skills.action_en: Assemble every flight subsystem, then use the L2 console to deploy, plan, guide, expose and process in order.
skills.action_zh: 先装齐飞行子系统。进入 L2 控制台后，从左到右完成展开、热控、导星、曝光和处理。
skills.success_en: Deployment is complete, thermal status is safe, guidance is locked and the first NIRCam frame is usable.
skills.success_zh: 展开完成、温度安全、导星锁定，并获得可用的第一帧 NIRCam 图像。
skills.recovery_en: A disabled stage means an earlier dependency is incomplete; read the stage strip from left to right.
skills.recovery_zh: 后面的阶段点不了，说明前面还有一步没完成。从左到右看，先处理第一个没亮的标签。

skills.title_zh: 为什么是红外，为什么要去太空
skills.why_en: Earth's atmosphere blocks much infrared light and glows thermally, while a cold space observatory can detect faint heat from the universe.
skills.why_zh: 地球大气会挡住不少红外，温暖的空气还会自己发光。把望远镜送进太空并降温，微弱热信号才不会被盖住。
skills.action_en: Use the space console rather than an eyepiece: verify temperature and pointing, choose NIRCam, guide, expose and process.
skills.action_zh: 这次没有目镜。先确认温度和指向，选择 NIRCam，再完成导星、曝光和处理。
skills.success_en: Dust-hidden structure appears in the infrared result while the thermal and guidance checks remain valid.
skills.success_zh: 被尘埃遮挡的结构会在红外结果中显现，同时热控和导星检查保持有效。
skills.recovery_en: If the result is blank or noisy, inspect temperature, guide lock and filter before repeating the exposure.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果结果空白或噪声很高，先检查温度、导星锁定和滤镜，再重新曝光。

skills.why_en: Different infrared filters isolate different temperatures and structures; one frame cannot answer every question.
skills.why_zh: 不同红外滤镜看的东西不一样。有的突出恒星，有的更容易看穿尘埃。
skills.action_en: Choose the star-forming filter, guide accurately, expose, then compare its knots with the broad-band frame.
skills.action_zh: 选择恒星形成滤镜，精确导星并曝光，再把年轻恒星结点与宽带图像比较。
skills.success_en: Young stellar knots gain contrast while the background remains controlled.
skills.success_zh: 年轻恒星结点的对比度明显提高，同时背景仍保持可控。
skills.recovery_en: If nothing changes, verify the active filter and repeat processing instead of increasing exposure blindly.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果画面没有变化，先确认当前滤镜并重新处理，不要盲目增加曝光。

skills.why_en: Mid-infrared detectors see cold dust, but they also see the telescope's own heat unless the system is extremely cold.
skills.why_zh: MIRI 能看冷尘埃，也会看见望远镜自己发出的热。温度不够低，目标就会淹在热噪声里。
skills.action_en: Complete the thermal stage before selecting MIRI, then expose only after the temperature readout is safe.
skills.action_zh: 先完成热控阶段，再选择 MIRI；温度读数进入安全范围后才能曝光。
skills.success_en: Thermal noise falls below the limit and cold dust appears in the processed frame.
skills.success_zh: 热噪声降到门槛以下，处理后的图像中会显现冷尘埃。
skills.recovery_en: If the frame is flooded by noise, stop exposure and cool the instrument instead of processing harder.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果图像被热噪声淹没，先停止曝光并继续降温，而不是强行处理。

skills.why_en: An image shows shape, while a spectrum reveals composition and redshift.
skills.why_zh: 图像告诉我们形状，光谱则能揭示成分和红移。
skills.action_en: Select NIRSpec, acquire a stable guide star, expose, then inspect the shifted spectral features.
skills.action_zh: 选择 NIRSpec，稳定锁定导星，完成曝光后检查发生偏移的光谱特征。
skills.success_en: The signal-to-noise ratio is sufficient and the expected spectral features can be measured.
skills.success_zh: 信噪比达到要求，并能测量预期的光谱特征。
skills.recovery_en: If the spectrum is noisy, improve guiding or integration time before drawing a conclusion.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果光谱噪声太大，先改善导星或积分时间，再进行判断。

skills.why_en: A space telescope must protect its cold side from the Sun, so not every pointing angle is safe.
skills.why_zh: 空间望远镜必须让冷端避开太阳，因此并不是所有指向角度都安全。
skills.action_en: Re-point in small steps until the attitude indicator enters the safe region, then continue the observation.
skills.action_zh: 小幅调整指向，直到姿态指示进入安全区域，再继续观测。
skills.success_en: The sun-angle warning clears without losing the target plan.
skills.success_zh: 太阳夹角警告消失，同时目标规划仍被保留。
skills.recovery_en: If the warning grows, reverse the last adjustment; never force an exposure in the forbidden region.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果警告加重，就反向撤回刚才的调整；绝不能在禁区内强行曝光。

skills.why_en: Visible, infrared and radio observations reveal different physical parts of the same object.
skills.why_zh: 同一个天体，换个波段就会露出不同结构。可见光、红外和射电不是三张同样的照片。
skills.action_en: Choose the observatory that measures the required signal, then compare the results instead of treating them as identical pictures.
skills.action_zh: 先看任务要找哪种信号，再选对应的观测设备。完成后把几个波段的结果放在一起看。
skills.success_en: Each wavelength contributes a distinct piece of evidence and the combined conclusion matches all of them.
skills.success_zh: 几个波段各自补上一块信息，放在一起就能看懂这个天体的结构。
skills.recovery_en: If a device cannot answer the question, return to the selector and match the instrument to the requested wavelength.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果看不到任务要找的结构，就返回选择界面，检查仪器波段是否选对。

skills.why_en: Very faint structure emerges by accumulating signal over time, not by making one frame excessively bright.
skills.why_zh: 极暗结构依靠长时间累积信号显现，而不是把单帧图像调得过亮。
skills.action_en: Keep guidance stable, collect multiple integrations, then stack and reject damaged samples.
skills.action_zh: 保持导星稳定，收集多次积分，再进行叠加并剔除受损样本。
skills.success_en: The faint structure rises above the noise while bright regions remain unsaturated.
skills.success_zh: 暗弱结构从噪声中显现，同时明亮区域没有过曝。
skills.recovery_en: If noise remains, add clean integrations; if highlights clip, shorten each exposure before stacking.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果噪声仍高，就增加干净积分；如果高光溢出，就先缩短单次曝光再叠加。

skills.why_en: A bright cool giant can saturate a sensitive mid-infrared detector even when the instrument is correctly cooled.
skills.why_zh: 明亮冷巨星即使在仪器正确降温后，也可能让灵敏的中红外探测器过曝。
skills.action_en: Use the required MIRI mode but shorten the exposure and monitor the saturation warning.
skills.action_zh: 使用任务要求的 MIRI 模式，同时缩短曝光并观察过曝警告。
skills.success_en: The stellar signal remains below the clipping limit while useful cool-spectrum detail is preserved.
skills.success_zh: 恒星信号保持在截断门槛以下，同时保留有用的低温光谱细节。
skills.recovery_en: If pixels clip, reduce exposure time; cooling cannot recover information already saturated.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果像素已经溢出，就缩短曝光；继续降温无法恢复已经过曝的信息。

skills.why_en: A narrow filter isolates glowing ionised gas, and mapped colour makes that invisible measurement readable.
skills.why_zh: 窄带滤镜能分离发光的电离气体，映射色则让不可见测量变得可读。
skills.action_en: Select the emission-line filter, process the calibrated frame, then assign colour according to measured intensity.
skills.action_zh: 选择发射线滤镜，处理校准后的图像，再按测得强度分配颜色。
skills.success_en: The colour map follows the gas signal rather than decorative or random colour.
skills.success_zh: 颜色分布会跟随气体信号，而不是装饰性或随机上色。
skills.recovery_en: If the map looks flat, confirm the filter and calibration before changing the colour mapping.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果图像没有层次，先确认滤镜和校准，再调整颜色映射。

skills.why_en: A scientific result is a chain of valid decisions; one perfect-looking image cannot excuse a broken earlier stage.
skills.why_zh: 最后的图像好不好，取决于前面每一步。导星、热控或校准出错，后期处理补不回来。
skills.action_en: Plan, cool, guide, align, expose, stack, reject cosmic rays, choose the filter and prepare the report in order.
skills.action_zh: 从规划开始，依次完成降温、导星、校准、曝光和叠加。剔除宇宙线后，再选滤镜并提交报告。
skills.success_en: Every stage reports ready and the final evidence is traceable back to clean measurements.
skills.success_zh: 所有阶段都已就绪，最终图像和原始测量也能相互对应。
skills.recovery_en: When the report is blocked, read the first incomplete stage rather than repeatedly pressing the final button.
skills.recovery_zh: 如果报告被阻止，请检查第一个未完成阶段，不要反复点击最后按钮。

skills.why_en: A radio telescope does not form an eyepiece picture. It measures weak signals with a dish, receiver and data chain.
skills.why_zh: FAST 不会给你拍一张照片。反射面把射电波送进接收机，控制台留下的是频谱、脉冲和信号强度。
skills.action_en: Assemble the dish and feed system, then use the radio console to point, tune, integrate and compare signal traces.
skills.action_zh: 先装好反射面、馈源和接收链。进入控制台后，稳住馈源舱、找对频段，再清干扰并积分。
skills.success_en: The source rises above background noise at the expected frequency and remains stable long enough to record.
skills.success_zh: 目标信号会在预期频率高于背景噪声，并稳定到足以记录。
skills.recovery_en: If no image appears, that is normal. Check pointing, receiver frequency and integration time instead.
skills.recovery_zh: 看不到照片是正常的。先检查馈源舱有没有锁定、频窗有没有罩住候选信号，再看积分时间够不够。
